entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that operates in either single-registration mode or dual-registration mode.

entities.name: SIM/USIM
entities.description: The subscriber identity module used by the UE for authentication and service access.

entities.name: SIM/USIM invalid for 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition where the UE considers the SIM/USIM invalid for any of the 3GPP access modes: N1 mode, S1 mode, A/Gb mode, or Iu mode.

entities.name: USIM invalid for 5GS services
entities.description: Condition where the UE considers the USIM invalid for 5GS services for any of the 3GPP access modes: N1 mode, S1 mode, A/Gb mode, or Iu mode.

entities.name: Consider SIM/USIM invalid for all 3GPP accesses
entities.description: System behavior where if the SIM/USIM is invalid for any 3GPP access mode, it is considered invalid for all 3GPP access modes.

entities.name: Consider USIM invalid for all 5GS services
entities.description: System behavior where if the USIM is invalid for 5GS services in any 3GPP access mode, it is considered invalid for 5GS services in all 3GPP access modes.

relations.description: If the UE considers the SIM/USIM invalid for any 3GPP access mode, it establishes the behavior to consider it invalid for all 3GPP access modes.
If the UE considers the USIM invalid for 5GS services in any 3GPP access mode, it establishes the behavior to consider it invalid for 5GS services in all 3GPP access modes.
The UE uses the SIM/USIM for authentication and service access across different modes.
